title: Mirror Orchard
user: Puzzle players who like novel visual mechanics but want past puzzles and a low-pressure way to learn them instead of being locked into a single daily attempt.
smallest_useful_product: A seed-based visual symmetry game about growing a mirrored orchard: one daily featured puzzle plus an always-open, ordered archive of 40 teaching boards and replayable personal seeds.
success_measure: At least half of new players finish three archived teaching boards before attempting the daily puzzle, with 20% returning within a week.
constraints: Invent an independently designed symmetry rule and visual language; make every state distinguishable without color; preserve seed reproducibility.
catalog_description: Grow mirrored orchard patterns across 40 teaching boards, a daily puzzle, and replayable seeds.
